component.name: Void Watcher
component.summary: Date, time, and calendar for the COSMIC panel

description.p: Void Watcher puts the date and time in your COSMIC panel and a month calendar one click away. It reads the same settings the stock clock does, so whatever you pick in Settings › Date & Time — 24-hour time, seconds, weekday, date in the panel, first day of the week, even a custom format — Void Watcher follows it. Nothing to configure twice.

ul.li: Panel clock that follows your Date & Time settings live
Month calendar popup with previous/next navigation and a jump back to today
Works on horizontal and vertical panels
